Olden Retriever

A platformer game for the Game Boy, featuring an old dog and balloons. Play in your browser, in a Game Boy emulator, or on a real Game Boy (via flash cart).

This game was created in 10 days for the GBJAM 14 game jam. I unfortunately didn't have enough time to add music.

Controls

Game BoyBrowserAction
⬅➡⬅➡Move horizontally
A or ⬆Z or ⬆Use balloon
B or ⬇X or ⬇Pop balloon
SelectShiftReload checkpoint
[ ]Change palette (see below)

In the browser, the GameBoy emulator (binjgb) supports using [ and ] keys to change color palettes. Some of these palettes have different colors for sprites vs background tiles. This is consistent with how the GameBoy Color behaves when playing non-color games, but for the purposes of GBJAM judging (which requires submitted games to have 4 or fewer colors), please disregard these extra palettes.
